participant_requirement: A participant who has not read the issue bodies or authored the Tour changes.

passing_evidence: The program disappeared across callbacks, queues, processes, launch/configuration, providers and hosts.
Authored meaning needed to stay distinct from the exact implementation selected today.
Pressure, lifecycle, authority and evidence needed to become visible parts of the program.
A living rhythm/light instrument that starts and stops explicitly.
A bounded persistent service that waits, applies pressure, survives one worker failure and drains.
A simulated Pete rehearsal with isolated networking, exact placement, finite authority and safe degradation.

questions.prompt: Why did you need each new idea?
passing_evidence: Clock for repeatable rhythm; explicit flow for a second layer and pressure.
State and delay for meaningful recurrence; Watch for non-invasive observation.
Waiting, capacity and supervision for the service.
Provider choice, leases, deadlines and degradation for the rehearsal.

questions.prompt: What do you want to build next?
passing_evidence: The participant names a concrete extension of one artifact or another system whose full program they want to keep visible.
